# phron_server (Resource)

A Phron Server: a virtual server with its own public IPv6 /64, billed hourly. Creating it waits until the Server is running; destroying it deletes the Server, its disk and its backups for good.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "phron_server" "web" {
  name                = "web-1"
  location            = "fsn1" # an id from data.phron_locations
  operating_system_id = data.phron_operating_systems.all.operating_systems[0].id
  ssh_key_ids         = [phron_ssh_key.admin.id]

  tier       = "shared"
  vcpus      = 2
  memory_gib = 4
  disk_gib   = 40

  user_data = <<-EOT
    #cloud-config
    packages:
      - nginx
  EOT
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `disk_gib` (Number) Disk in GiB.
- `location` (String) The Location id the Server lives in for good; see the phron_locations data source.
- `memory_gib` (Number) Memory in GiB.
- `name` (String) The Server's name, 1 to 63 characters. Changing it replaces the Server (the API has no rename).
- `operating_system_id` (String) The Operating System id; see the phron_operating_systems data source.
- `ssh_key_ids` (Set of String) Ids of saved SSH keys (phron_ssh_key), installed at first boot. At least one is required.
- `vcpus` (Number) Number of vCPUs. Changing the size resizes the Server in place (the disk can grow, never shrink).

### Optional

- `restore_from_backup_id` (String) Start the Server from a Backup or Snapshot of a deleted Server of the same Organization. The Operating System of that Server is used and operating_system_id is ignored by the API.
- `tier` (String) "shared" (default) or "dedicated" vCPUs. A Server keeps its tier: changing it replaces the Server.
- `user_data` (String, Sensitive) Cloud-init user data run once at first boot, after the platform's own part: plain text of at most 65536 bytes whose first line is `#cloud-config`, `#!`, `#cloud-boothook` or `#include`. Never returned by the API, so it is kept from your configuration. Not a place for secrets: anyone who can read the guest's disk can read it. Changing it replaces the Server (cloud-init runs once per instance); setting it on an imported Server does not.
- `workspace_id` (String) The Workspace the Server belongs to for good. Empty means the Organization's default Workspace.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The Server id.
- `ipv6_prefix` (String) The Server's public IPv6 prefix.
- `power` (String) The observed power state, for example "running".
- `ssh_address` (String) The address to ssh to.
- `state` (String) The lifecycle state, for example "running" or "stopped".

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import phron_server.web <server id>
```
